notes.title: Game flow and bug fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44265323/5eac8180b11ad7be8a26c49ee6d0cd6400538066.png

Game Patch

 New items have been added.
[olist]
 Shield: Grants invincibility to the player for a certain duration upon getting hit.
 AttackSpeed: Increases attack speed.
 Caltrop: When a bomb explodes, it releases 3 Caltrops.
 Web : Removing spider webs.
 Drone : Temporarily pausing the drone.
[/olist]
 Increased item drop probability.
 Adjusted boss health and level.


optimization

 We have optimized the game to allow only the necessary items to appear.


Bug Fix

 Fixed the bug where the gauge was filled to 100 when re-entering the game after changing the sound.
 Modified the pause function to be available only when the player is active.

notes.title: Minor patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44265323/dd4b83e840e3fb002d4eb3da9ef4f26fa67fc705.png

Bomber Patch

We have patched the second boss, Bomber, in Chapter 1. Previously, Bomber's bombs would be placed at the player's position, making it impossible to avoid them when the player performed stationary attacks. We received feedback stating that this made the game progression difficult.

I agreed with this feedback, and in this patch, we have made a modification so that Bomber's bombs no longer explode upon contact with the player's Kunai. They will now pass through without detonating.
